faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Surat (IIIT Surat) for hiring a qualified professional on a contract basis in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official notification has been released for the position of Counsellor Psychologist under advertisement number IIITS/RNF/2026-27/03.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in IIIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Counsellor Psychologist post. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 20 October 2026. Make sure to complete your submissions well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a walk-in interview scheduled for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a walk-in interview is scheduled for 21 October 2026. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required original documents and photocopies at the campus.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Counsellor Psychologist position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of 50,000/- per month as per institutional guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. Please verify your age against the notification cutoff date before submitting your application form.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Ph.D. in Clinical/Counselling Psychology, a Master's in Psychology, or a Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, or Sociology with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIIT Surat Counsellor Psychologist?
faq.answer: The selection process entirely consists of an in-person interview. Candidates must bring their original certificates and set of photocopies during the walk-in date.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Candidates need to fill out the Google Form and submit the required application along with necessary documents online by the last date, followed by attending the walk-in interview.
